run_suite_load_without_kwargs: run suite.load to create a cartpole swingup environment without any task kwargs
run_suite_load_with_kwargs: run suite.load to create a cartpole swingup environment with custom time_limit and random kwargs
test_loader_load_without_kwargs: test the LoaderTest.test_load_without_kwargs method to verify basic environment loading returns a control.Environment
test_loader_load_with_kwargs: test the LoaderTest.test_load_with_kwargs method to verify environment loading with task_kwargs returns a control.Environment
test_loader_constants: test the LoaderConstantsTest.testSuiteConstants method to verify BENCHMARKING, EASY, HARD, and EXTRA suite constants are non-empty
